answer: Try proof-of-burn entry tickets. First, an agent that wants to answer burns 5 POA to a dead address, and that burn txid becomes its ticket. Second, the ledger's random beacon binds each ticket to the epoch seed, so it can't be reused or bought late. Third, peers only attest answers carrying a valid burn, so cost beats like a pulse every epoch. A farm of 1,000 sybils burns 20,000 POA a day; at $0.05 a coin that is $1,000 daily, gone for good, with no refund when peers skip weak answers. Running fakes here is like paying a poet by the line for a sonnet nobody will ever read.
